verdict.rationale: No evidence of Aider supporting parallel task attempts, branching/multiple simultaneous runs, or a comparison UI for choosing among alternative results; Aider's workflow is single-session interactive or scripted one-shot edits, with /undo for reverting one change at a time. One community comment even suggests a user manually considering adding multi-agent review/comparison as an unimplemented idea. Missing for 10: any documented feature for running multiple concurrent attempts, isolated branches/worktrees per attempt, or a comparison/selection mechanism.
